content.text:
Here are good places to order a birthday cake online in the U.S., depending on what you need:

**Fast / local delivery**
- **Instacart** — order cakes from nearby grocery stores, bakeries, Costco/Sam’s-style stores, etc.; often same-day depending on your area. Good for basic sheet cakes, ice cream cakes, and last-minute options. ([instacart.com](https://www.instacart.com/cake-delivery?msockid=0a91e198ca3d61653a14f744cb876021&utm_source=openai))
- **DoorDash / Uber Eats / Grubhub** — best if you want a local bakery or dessert shop delivered same-day. Availability depends on your ZIP code.
- **Walmart, Whole Foods, Safeway, Kroger, Publix, Wegmans, Costco, Sam’s Club** — many let you order cakes online for pickup; some support delivery through their site or delivery partners.

**Nationwide shipping / giftable cakes**
- **Goldbelly** — ships birthday cakes from well-known bakeries across the U.S.; good for “special occasion” cakes. ([goldbelly.com](https://www.goldbelly.com/collections/best-birthday-cakes?utm_source=openai))
- **Milk Bar** — famous for Birthday Cake and cake truffles; offers nationwide shipping and some local delivery options. ([milkbarstore.com](https://milkbarstore.com/pages/delivery?utm_source=openai))
- **Bake Me A Wish!** — specializes in nationwide birthday cake delivery. ([bakemeawish.com](https://www.bakemeawish.com/?utm_source=openai))
- **Carlo’s Bakery** — offers nationwide shipping and local pickup options, including birthday cakes. ([shop.carlosbakery.com](https://shop.carlosbakery.com/?utm_source=openai))
- **Sprinkles** — cakes/cupcakes with local pickup/delivery in some cities and nationwide shipping for some items. ([sprinkles.com](https://sprinkles.com/?utm_source=openai))

**My quick recommendation:**  
- Need it **today or tomorrow**: try **Instacart** or **DoorDash/Uber Eats** with your ZIP code.  
- Want something more memorable: try **Goldbelly**, **Milk Bar**, or **Carlo’s Bakery**.  
- Need a **custom message/photo/theme**: order directly from a local grocery bakery or local bakery website if possible.

If you tell me the **delivery ZIP code**, **date needed**, and **budget**, I can narrow it down to the best options.
